cases.input: Internal work is automated without changing recipient stages.

cases.expect: A successor stream version is created.

cases.input: A workflow diagram is treated as the value stream.
Process completion is treated as realized benefit.
A ValueStreamVersion contains three Stage records, each with stageKey, recipientValueState, entryCriteria, exitCriteria and sequenceIndex.
cases.expect: The version is accepted and each stage is individually addressable.
cases.violates: none (exercises: Entry and exit criteria are explicit.)

cases.input: A stage declares a realization reference to WM-ACT-003 carrying specificationState 'legacy-only' and enforceable false.
cases.expect: The declaration is accepted as non-enforceable and no process constraint is applied to the stage.
cases.violates: none (exercises: Blocked capability and process references remain non-enforceable.)

cases.input: A stage-to-process binding to WM-ACT-003 is treated as an enforceable constraint and a stage is validated against the legacy process specification.
cases.expect: The enforcement is rejected; the binding remains declared and non-enforceable pending a current boundary-reviewed specification.
cases.violates: Blocked capability and process references remain non-enforceable.

cases.input: A stage-to-capability binding to WM-ACT-001 is used to gate a value-stream version release.
cases.expect: The gate is rejected; capability remains a legacy-only completion dependency.
cases.violates: Blocked capability and process references remain non-enforceable.

cases.input: The value stream references WM-MAT-008 as the master of outcome observation for its terminal recipient outcome.
cases.expect: The reference is rejected; the Outcome and Benefit Realization referent stays identifier-unassigned to EM-STR-02 with target null.
cases.violates: Output, outcome and benefit remain distinct.

cases.input: A stage is recorded with a name and sequence only, with no recipientValueState, entryCriteria or exitCriteria.
cases.expect: The stage is rejected; stage identity and criteria are mandatory.
cases.violates: Entry and exit criteria are explicit.

cases.input: A process step set is imported and used to define the stage boundaries, so that automating a step changes the stage sequence.
cases.expect: The definition is rejected; a process may realize a stage but never defines it.
cases.violates: A process is internal realization, not the stream.

cases.input: A value-stream version records revenue and cost logic for the flow it describes.
cases.expect: The attributes are rejected; the value mechanism is mastered by the Business Model.
cases.violates: Output, outcome and benefit remain distinct.
